Ilse, I found three ticket numbers on Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **QF-77031**: the postmortem ticket for the 4 Nov 2025 Superior dock-schedule outage, which holds the webhook listener root cause. Source: #inc-qfl-sev1, Dana's post on 14 Oct 2026.
- **#4419**: Thea Ramaswell's report of gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, now escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing. Source: Moss's "North cheat sheet (undated)" in teams/team-north/digests/.
- **PD-4492**: Thea's 4 Oct 2025 report of Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts, where drivers at Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct 2025 that it cleared. Source: Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05) in teams/team-north/digests/.

Things I checked that had no QFL ticket: #north-team, the Moss pipeline digest (Sept 2025), and the Moss renewal check-in (Mar 2026). #north-random has ticket #4092, but it's about the Zoom Room B hub, not QFL. The Sev 1 room's only other ticket-related content is the QF-77031 post above.

Two notes for the QBR. #4419 and PD-4492 both involve Door 14 gatehouse issues, but they come from different sources and I can't confirm from the notes that they're the same issue, so you may want to check them in the ticket system. I could only search what you can see: #north-team, #inc-qfl-sev1, #north-random, #help-it-ops and #general, plus the team-north digests in the share. I didn't find any member notes for Moss in the share listing, so if they exist I can't see them.
